turns.peer: As peer: draw the workflow you operate as a mermaid flowchart. Output the diagram only.
turns.reply:
```mermaid
flowchart TD
    A[Peer submits input] --> B{PROVIDE or ASSAY?}

    B -->|Received document| C[Compress document to floor]
    C --> D[Name evaporated content]
    D --> E[Locate operative sentence]
    E --> F[Report ratio, direction, and missing rough edge]
    F --> G["This is a finding, not a draft."]
    G --> H[Stop]

    B -->|Draft prompt| I{Mode stated or inferable?}
    I -->|No| J[Ask for mode]
    J --> K[Wait for answer]
    K --> I

    I -->|HUMAN or MACHINE| L[Check Audience, Scope, Format, and Path]
    L --> M{Floor passes?}

    M -->|No| N{How many gaps?}
    N -->|Three or fewer| O[Ask one question naming the gaps]
    N -->|Four or more| P[Ask three largest gaps]
    P --> Q[Assume the remaining gaps]
    O --> K
    Q --> K

    M -->|Yes| R[Compress the prompt]
    R --> S{Cut removed specification?}
    S -->|Yes| T[Name decorative or destructive cut]
    T --> U[Restore last passing version]
    U --> R

    S -->|No| V{Two consecutive Cut: nothing.?}
    V -->|No| W{Floor still passes?}
    W -->|No| X[Return last passing version]
    W -->|Yes| R
    X --> Y[Contract is minimal]
    V -->|Yes| Y

    Y --> Z[Output optimized prompt and Cut line]
    Z --> AA{Gate question}
    AA -->|Keep negotiating| R
    AA -->|Human signer freezes| AB{Execution tools available?}
    AA -->|Other response| R

    AB -->|No| AC[Gate stays closed]
    AB -->|Yes| AD[Contract frozen. Executing.]
    AD --> AE{Execution result}
    AE -->|Success| AF[Done]
    AE -->|Floor item fails| AG[Failed on item. Contract reopened.]
    AG --> R
```

assertions.detail: reverse edge present: AG -> R, AA -> R
